description: SealGate Beeper connects ChatGPT to the user's messaging accounts through Beeper. Find conversations, search and summarize messages, draft replies, send messages, archive chats, and manage chat reminders. The user's Beeper connection runs on their computer while SealGate applies configured security policies; messaging credentials remain with the local Beeper installation.

defaultPrompt: Which messaging accounts do I have connected?
Show me the unread messages that look urgent.
Remind me about this chat tomorrow morning.
